Subject: PO vs Card - Procurement next steps (ProcureCo)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- What we heard: Procurement prefers to pay via Purchase Order (PO) for enterprise vendors. AP team typically requires vendor onboarding (W-9, COI, vendor form) and a 3–4 week timeline for new vendors. For small pilot work (under $10k) they will allow credit card payments to speed things up.
- Redwood options: we support (1) PO + Net30 invoices for enterprise contracts, (2) credit card for self-serve/short pilots, and (3) AWS Marketplace (if you prefer consolidated procurement through your cloud marketplace).

Action items / suggested next steps:
1) If you want to proceed with PO path: can you share your vendor onboarding packet and PO template? I’ll route to our Finance team and get a target timeline.
2) If you want to pilot faster: we can invoice to a credit card for the initial 30-day pilot (< $10k).
3) If marketplace billing is preferred we can confirm Redwood’s listing and provide marketplace MSA details.

I’ve attached a draft SOW for reference and a short commercial summary to help with internal approvals.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (stub)

If you want, I can loop in our Finance/Legal leads; otherwise please send the vendor form and PO template and I’ll get things moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming procurement prefers PO for any vendor onboarding. We require the following to onboard a new vendor:
- Completed vendor onboarding form
- W-9 (or local equivalent)
- Certificate of Insurance (COI)
- Signed vendor agreement (if applicable)

Timeline: typically 3–4 weeks from receipt of the completed packet.

Pilot option: We can pay via corporate card for an initial pilot up to $10k while onboarding proceeds, which might be the fastest path to start.

Marketplace: We use AWS Marketplace for a handful of vendors. If Redwood is listed, procurement will evaluate marketplace billing, but sometimes marketplace pricing and SKUs add complexity; please share details if you have a Marketplace listing.

I’ve attached our vendor form to this reply.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement
ProcureCo
